retrieval_note: Retrieved by rendering https://pmkisan.gov.in/ in a real browser on 2026-11-08 (the site serves an incomplete TLS chain, so plain HTTP clients fail verification; verification was NOT disabled). Statements below are copied verbatim from the page text. Nothing here was written from memory.

schemes.source_title: PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi — home page, 'PM-KISAN Scheme' and 'Scheme Exclusion' sections
schemes.jurisdiction: Government of India — Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

statements.text: PM Kisan is a Central Sector scheme with 100% funding from Government of India.
Under the scheme an income support of 6,000/- per year in three equal installments will be provided to all land holding farmer families.
Definition of family for the scheme is husband, wife and minor children.
State Government and UT administration will identify the farmer families which are eligible for support as per scheme guidelines.
The fund will be directly transferred to the bank accounts of the beneficiaries.
All Persons who paid Income Tax in last assessment year
All superannuated/retired pensioners whose monthly pension is Rs.10,000/-or more (Excluding Multi Tasking Staff / Class IV/Group D employees) of above category
Professionals like Doctors, Engineers, Lawyers, Chartered Accountants, and Architects registered with Professional bodies and carrying out profession by undertaking practices.
eKYC is MANDATORY for PMKISAN Registered Farmers.
The site's 'Farmers Corner' offers 'New Farmer Registration' and 'Know Your Status'.

required_documents.note: The official home page does not list required documents. GramSetu does not state a document list until one is verified from an official source.

schemes.verification_notes: Eligibility is decided by State/UT administration per scheme guidelines; GramSetu never declares a person eligible.
